rationale: The assistant immediately framed wet plastics as normal, asked the right first questions (rinse aid, programme, whether the load is hot at the end) and used the customer's answers to rule out a heating fault ('hot, steamy finish makes a heating fault unlikely'). It correctly identified empty rinse aid despite all-in-one tablets plus Eco 50 condensation drying as the cause, matching the hidden truth, with appropriately hedged confidence and no parts or engineer. It did not explicitly ask about unloading timing or tight loading, though it did advise cracking the door open after the cycle; overall a well-served homeowner.
